title: Employee's Compensation private-beta review decision
authorityBoundary: The deterministic rule executes before retrieval and provider output.
Complete and reported-gap inputs remain specialist-review.

Retrieval and provider output cannot classify a worker, decide ESI coverage, infer injury, disease, medical, wage or dependency facts, determine liability, calculate compensation or decide a claim or alter the deterministic result.
privacyBoundary: No names, contact details, addresses, registration numbers, employee or dependant identities, age, sex, payroll, wages, payslips, attendance, service records, accident or injury narratives, medical or death information, claims, disputes, notices, orders, bank/payment data or evidence bodies.
Only controlled source-route, Chapter VII, schedule, Rules, commencement, transition, ESI-overlap, employer-process, authority-process, escalation statuses and evidence references may be processed.
sourceBoundary: The pack reuses four exact controlled Social Security files already registered in the Source Register.
First, Second, Third and Sixth Schedule materials are source-readiness inputs only and cannot create customer applicability, injury, liability or individual entitlement.
State and Union Territory instruments and customer-specific facts remain outside this bounded wave.

approval.notes: Software implementation and tests do not constitute legal, privacy, RAG, source-file, security or release approval.
